nodes.description: Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom; mutates balanceOf and allowance with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
Internal view whitelist gate; returns true for owner/trade/UNI/pair/canSale senders, otherwise requires condition().
Public payable approve; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-condition checker using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function that performs delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hardcoded address; sets balanceOf and canSale.
Owner-only initializer that sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer that multiplies _value by _tos.length and loops over recipients.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using keccak256.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balances and allowance to the router.
Private privileged owner address controlling delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of account balances mutated in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances used by transferFrom and approve.
Private mapping marking addresses whitelisted for sale by _mints.
Address that is whitelisted in ensure and set by setTradeAddress.
Private sale-count limit set by init and read by condition.
Private minimum sale amount set by init and read by condition.
Private maximum sale amount set by init and read by condition.
Private per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Public total supply set in the constructor.
Constant decimals value used to scale minted and initialized amounts.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure.
Attacker-controlled caller address used for auth checks, allowance lookups and balance mutations.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address with attacker/owner-supplied calldata; executes foreign code in this contract context.
Raw -= and += mutations of balanceOf and allowance inside transferFrom without SafeMath.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length and raw balance subtraction inside batchSend.

Destination address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.

Arbitrary calldata passed to the delegatecall in delegate.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source address.
transferFrom calls ensure() before mutating balances, gating non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() requires condition(_from, _value) for senders not in the whitelist.
ensure() derives the Uniswap pair via pairFor for whitelist comparison.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom increments the _onSaleNum counter of the sender.
msg.sender determines the spender side of the allowance check in transferFrom.
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) before performing the delegatecall.
_mints is gated by msg.sender being owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
init is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
approve writes allowance indexed by the untrusted caller msg.sender.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
Parameter a is the arbitrary target address supplied to the delegatecall.
Parameter b is arbitrary calldata passed to the delegatecall.
delegate() reaches the unsafe delegatecall operation on the supplied target.
_value flows into the unchecked balance and allowance mutations of transferFrom.
_from indexes balanceOf[_from] and _onSaleNum[_from] state before external effects finalize.
_tos.length feeds the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
addedValue is assigned into balanceOf[spender] in _mints.
addedValue is the amount operand used by the privileged _mints routine.
spender is marked in canSale, granting whitelist status for ensure().
_from is passed into condition() to look up _onSaleNum[_from].
tradeAddress is compared in the ensure() whitelist bypass branch.
canSale[_from] grants a whitelist bypass in ensure().
owner is compared in the ensure() whitelist bypass branch.
The constant UNI router address is compared in the ensure() whitelist branch.
_saleNum bounds the number of sales permitted by condition().
_minSale lower-bounds the transfer value checked in condition().
_maxSale upper-bounds the transfer value checked in condition().
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared against _saleNum inside condition().
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting the address.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue scaled by decimals.
setTradeAddress writes the addr argument into the tradeAddress state variable.
init assigns token-derived value to the _minSale state variable.
init assigns maxToken-derived value to the _maxSale state variable.
init assigns saleNum to the _saleNum state variable.
The constructor sets owner from msg.sender and grants it the full supply.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for msg.sender and each recipient with unchecked arithmetic.
The local total value is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] in batchSend.
The loop index i drives the recipient iteration in batchSend.
The loop-local _to is credited balanceOf[_to] += _value in batchSend.
The locally computed _UNI pair address participates in the ensure() whitelist check.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter is an argument of transferFrom and is normalized into that function node.
The _to parameter is an argument of transferFrom and is normalized into that function node.
The _value parameter is an argument of transferFrom and is normalized into that function node.
The _spender parameter exists only to index the allowance write in approve.
The _tos array parameter is consumed by the batchSend iteration.
The spender parameter is the account mutated by _mints and normalizes into it.
The addedValue parameter is the balance operand of _mints.
The saleNum parameter is assigned to state only inside init.
The token parameter is assigned to state only inside init.
The maxToken parameter is assigned to state only inside init.
The addr parameter is written to tradeAddress only inside setTradeAddress.
Parameter a is the arbitrary target passed to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Parameter b is the arbitrary calldata passed to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
The _name parameter initializes state in the constructor.
The _symbol parameter initializes state in the constructor.
The _supply parameter determines totalSupply in the constructor.
The total local variable is the product that feeds the unchecked balance subtraction.
The loop index i is a transient counter inside batchSend.
The loop-local _to is a temporary recipient alias inside batchSend.
The _UNI local pair address is only used inside the ensure whitelist comparison.
